title: Doctoral Programmes in Germany
summary: This scholarship programme offers international graduates and doctoral candidates the opportunity to complete a doctoral degree or structured doctoral study programme at a state or state-recognised institution of higher education or non-university research institute in Germany.

degree_levels.notes: Offers the opportunity to complete your doctoral degree. Applicants must have completed a Master's degree or Diplom, or in exceptional cases a Bachelor's degree.

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines are eligible; specific regulations apply to human medicine, veterinary medicine, and dentistry.

institutions.notes: A state or state-recognised institution of higher education or a non-university research institute in Germany.

nationality.notes: Restricted to countries listed in the database selection dropdown. If your status and/or country is not included in the list, you cannot apply.

residence.notes: Your application cannot be considered if you have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

mandatory.text: Above-average qualifications and completed Master's degree or Diplom, or in exceptional cases a Bachelor's degree, at the latest by the time the funding period begins.
Most recent university degree should have been obtained no more than six years ago before the application deadline.
If already started, the start of the doctorate should not be longer than 3 years ago at the time of application.
Not resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

exceptions.text: For applicants from the fields of human medicine, veterinary medicine and dentistry, other regulations are applicable.

funding.description: Monthly payments of 1,400 euros. Payments towards health, accident and personal liability insurance cover. Travel allowance (upon application only). Annual research allowance of €460. Additional benefits under certain circumstances: monthly rent subsidy, monthly allowance for accompanying family members, and subsidy for disability or chronic illness. Online language course fees, preparatory language course funding, allowance for a personally chosen German language course, and reimbursement for TestDaF or DSH test fees.
funding.duration: Initially awarded for a maximum of three years; can be extended for a fourth year (maximum of four years in total).

application_rounds.notes: Applications are possible between 1 June and the stated application deadline (updated annually in the second quarter).

recurring_deadline_notes: Applications are possible between 1 June and the stated application deadline annually.

required_documents.text: Full curriculum vitae in tabular form (max. 3 pages)
List of publications (max. 10 pages), if applicable
Description of academic and personal reasons for your planned project in Germany (letter of motivation: 1-2 pages)
A proposal, prepared and formulated by yourself, as well as a description of previous research work (max. 10 pages in total)
Schedule for planned research work (for individual projects)
Letter confirming supervision by the doctoral supervisor (for individual projects)
Module plan (for structured doctoral study programmes)
Proof of existing contacts to the coordinator of the doctoral programme (for structured doctoral study programmes)
Letter of admission to a study programme (for structured doctoral study programmes, may be submitted later)
Declaration from the scientific supervisor in Germany on safety-relevant and ethical aspects
All university degree certificates already obtained, stating final grade(s)
Transcripts of Records (undergraduate and postgraduate programmes)
One recent, supporting letter of recommendation from a university teacher

steps.text: Request and generate recommendation form as a writable PDF in the portal and have it completed by a university teacher
Prepare application documents and translate them into German or English if necessary
Scan paper documents and save in PDF format
Complete the online application form in the DAAD portal, upload all required attachments, and submit online

sources.title: Doctoral Programmes in Germany - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme provides funding for international doctoral candidates to conduct research and complete a doctoral degree physically in Germany.
